description: How to answer an employee's or applicant's pay information request: what the jurisdiction's text says the answer covers (quoted), the due date, the route the text names where an answer would disclose an identifiable person's pay, and a neutral outline with placeholders. It fills in no figures and gives no advice. For the deadline alone: pay_request_deadline.

employer_headcount.description: Number of employees (staff, workforce size) of the employer.

jurisdiction.description: Country, US state or Canadian province code from list_jurisdictions, e.g. AT (Austria), IT (Italy), MT (Malta), PL (Poland), SK (Slovakia), US-CA (California), US-NY (New York), CA-ON (Ontario).

made_on.description: Date the request was made (YYYY-MM-DD), if earlier than the date it was received.

received_on.description: Date the employer received the pay information request (YYYY-MM-DD).

requester_type.description: Who asked: worker (employee), applicant (job candidate) or workers_representative.

name: pay_request_reply_outline
title: Pay-request reply outline
